Frequently asked questions

How many DevOps Engineer jobs are open in the United States?

Fortune Jobs AI lists 1,358 open DevOps Engineer jobs in the United States as of November 25, 2026.

How much do DevOps Engineer jobs in the United States pay?

The 25th–75th percentile of listed salary midpoints is $122,475–$182,440 a year, based on 404 listings where employers list pay. Listings without usable pay data are excluded; hourly and yearly pay are not mixed.

Which employers are hiring for DevOps Engineer jobs in the United States?

Employers in this catalogue include Maximus (104 listings), Deloitte (96 listings), HII's Mission Technologies division (39 listings), Lyric (39 listings), and SYSTOLIC (38 listings).

Do any DevOps Engineer jobs in the United States mention visa sponsorship or OPT?

2 listings mention visa sponsorship or OPT/CPT. A mention does not guarantee sponsorship or eligibility; confirm with the employer.

Are there entry-level DevOps Engineer jobs in the United States?

19 listings mention entry-level, new-grad, junior or graduate roles in the title or description. Review the original posting for its experience requirements.
